faq_heading: New construction in New Westminster: your questions answered

faq.q: What counts as new construction on this page?
faq.a: Active MLS® listings in New Westminster where the board's age field is 0 or less: homes finished this year and homes listed before completion, in houses, townhomes and condos.

faq.q: Where are the newest homes in New Westminster?
faq.a: Over the past year the newest sold homes were condos in Queensborough: median build year 2017, 53 sales, median price $690,000.

faq.q: How fast do newer homes sell in New Westminster?
faq.a: The quickest group among the newer ones was condos in Fraserview NW: 21 days to sell at a median, closing at 97.1% of the list price.

blocks.text: The search above shows active New Westminster listings that the MLS® records with an age of 0 or less. That picks up homes completed this year and homes listed before completion, in three types (houses, townhomes and condos), with land and income properties left out. The MLS® carries only part of the new-home market: developers sell many presale homes directly and list them late.
What newer homes in New Westminster have sold for
Queensborough led New Westminster for newness over November 2025 to October 2026. condos that sold there had a median build year of 2017 (53 sales, median price $690,000).

None of the 20 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later, so most of what sold was older stock; newer homes here are mostly first sales that never reach the resale shelf.

items.t: Queensborough condos: 53 sold at a median of $690,000 (middle half between $629,900 and $800,000), taking 33 days at 97.7% of the list price, with a median build year of 2017. The typical home had 2 bedrooms, it sold for about $655 per square foot, strata fees were a median $596 a month and 2% of the sales closed over the list price. The median held near $740,450 from the first quarter to the last.

In Queensborough, the 31 townhomes that sold had a median build year of 2014 and a median price of $855,000; the middle half closed between $790,000 and $916,500, after 26 days on the market at 97.8% of list. blocks.text: New Westminster overall: what sold over the past year

items.t: Across New Westminster, 150 houses sold at a median of $1,397,500, with the middle half between $1,225,000 and $1,636,558. They took 23 days and closed at 96.8% of the list price, and the median build year was 1951. The typical house sat on a lot of about 5,904 square feet. The median moved from $1,505,000 (November to January) to $1,365,000 (August to October).

New Westminster townhomes over the past year: 73 sales, a median of $871,000, and a middle half from $775,000 to $1,010,000. The median home was built in 2007, took 22 days to sell and closed at 97.8% of list. Strata fees were a median $496 a month. The median moved from $910,000 (November to January) to $855,000 (August to October).

Across New Westminster, 568 condos sold at a median of $580,000, with the middle half between $485,000 and $680,150. They took 28 days and closed at 97.3% of the list price, and the median build year was 2006. Strata fees were a median $547 a month. The median moved from $580,000 (November to January) to $545,000 (August to October).
